BiblicalUsage: A cleft hoof is the mark of a clean beast. Every beast that parteth the hoof and cleaveth the cleft into two claws and cheweth the cud, that ye shall eat. The swine divides the hoof but does not chew the cud, so he is unclean, and every beast that divides the hoof and is not clovenfooted is unclean to you.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the cleft hoof teaches that holiness is in the details. God gave Israel a mark they could see in the field, and I hold that He still asks His people to tell clean from unclean.
